questions.question: The radius of a right circular cylinder is thrice of its height. If the height of the cylinder is 2.1 cm, then what is the volume of cylinder?
questions.solution:
Given:

The radius of a right circular cylinder is thrice of its height. 

Height of the cylinder is 2.1 cm.

Concept used:

Volume of a cylinder = πR²H

where r = Radius of the base, h = height

Calculation:

Radius = 3 × 2.1 = 6.3 cm

The volume of the cylinder

⇒ π × 6.3² × 2.1

⇒ 261.954 cm3 ≈ 261.95 cm3

**∴ The volume of the cylinder is 261.95 cm3.**

questions.question: 5 men and 8 women can complete a work in 12 days working together, while 3 men and 7 women together can complete the same work in 15 days. In how many days will 11 women complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Given:

5 men and 8 women can complete a work in 12 days working together, while 3 men and 7 women together can complete the same work in 15 days.

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency of each worker × Number of Hours × Number of days to finish × Number of total workers

Calculation:

Let the efficiency of each man and woman be M and W respectively.

​According to the question,

(5M + 8W) × 12 = (3M + 7W) × 15

⇒ 60M + 96W = 45M + 105W

⇒ 15M = 9W

⇒ M = 3W/5 ....(1)

Now, time taken to complete the work by 11 women 

⇒ (5M + 8W) × 12 ÷ 11W

⇒ (3W + 8W) × 12 ÷ 11W (From 1)

⇒ 12 days

**∴ 11 women will complete the same work in 12 days.**

questions.question: A man bought a watch for 12% discount. If he had bought it for 24% discount, he would have got the watch for ₹2400 less. The marked price of the watch is:
questions.solution:
Given:

A man bought a watch for a 12% discount. 

If he had bought it for a 24% discount, he would have got the watch for ₹2400 less. 

Concept used:

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - Discount%)

Calculation:

Let the marked price be X.

​According to the question,

X × (24 - 12)% = 2400

⇒ X = 2400/12%

⇒ X = 20,000

∴ The marked price of the watch is ₹20,000.

questions.question: If the price of salt decreases by 20%, then by what percentage should consumption be increased to keep the expenditure same?
questions.solution:
Given:

The price of salt decreases by 20%.

Calculation:

Let the original price of 100 units of salt be Rs. 100.

Now the price of 100 units of salt = 100 - 100 × 20% = Rs. 80

Now the quantity of salt one can get for Rs. 100 = 100/80 × 100 = 125 gm

Now, % increase in consumption = frac {125 - 100}{100} × 100\% = 25%

**∴ By 25% the consumption should be increased to keep the expenditure the same.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

the price of salt decreases by 20%, Before : After = 5 : 4

To make the expenditure same, Consumption must be Before : After = 4 : 5

So, consumption increased by 1/4 × 100 = 25%

questions.question: A solid copper sphere of radius 9 cm is hammered and moulded into a wire of radius 2 cm. What is the length of this wire?
questions.solution:
Given:

A solid copper sphere of radius 9 cm is hammered and moulded into a wire of radius 2 cm. 

Concept used:

1. Volume of a cylinder = πR²H (r = Radius of the base, h = height)

2. Volume of a sphere = {4pi R³ over 3} (R is the radius of the sphere)

3. Volume of the sphere = Volume of the wire

Calculation:

Volume of the sphere = (4π × 9³)/3 cm³

Let the length of the wire be L.

​According to the question,

π × 2² × L = (4π × 93)/3

⇒ L = 243

∴ The length of the wire is 243 cm.

questions.question: A company employed 700 men and 300 women and the average wage was Rs. 450 per day. If a man got Rs. 50 more than a woman, then the daily wage of the women is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total employees = 700 + 300 = 1000

Total Wage = 1000 × 450 = Rs. 4,50,000

Extra amount given to 700 men = 700 × 50 = Rs. 35,000

Total wage if all were women = 4,50,000 − 35,000 = Rs. 4,15,000

Daily wage of a woman = 4,15,000 ÷ 1000 = Rs. 415

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of men (n₁) = 700

Number of women (n₂) = 300

Average wage of all employees = Rs. 450

Man wage − Woman wage = Rs. 50

**Formula Used:**

Combined Average = (n₁ × x₁ + n₂ × x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

 Wage: x

 Combined Avg = Rs. 450

Let the daily wage of a woman be Rs. x.

Daily wage of a man = Rs. (x + 50)

⇒ Total employees = 700 + 300 = 1000

⇒ Total daily wage = 1000 × 450 = 4,50,000

⇒ 700 × (x + 50) + 300 × x = 4,50,000

⇒ 700x + 35,000 + 300x = 4,50,000

⇒ 1000x + 35,000 = 4,50,000

⇒ 1000x = 4,50,000 − 35,000

⇒ 1000x = 4,15,000

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combined Average Formula

When two groups with averages A₁ and A₂ are mixed, the combined average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Weighted Average via Deviation

If the average is A, the sum of deviations of all observations from A is always zero.

questions.question: A, B, C are three angles of a triangle. If A - B = 45° and B - C = 15° then ∠A =?
questions.solution:
Given:

A, B, C are three angles of a triangle.

A - B = 45° and B - C = 15°

Concept used:

All internal angles of a triangle sum up to 180°.

Calculation:

∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180° ....(1)

∠A - ∠B = 45° ....(2)

∠B - ∠C = 15° ....(3)

(1) + (2) + (3),

2∠A + ∠B = 240° ....(4)

Solving (4) and (2), ∠A = 95°

**∴ The measure of ∠A is 95°.**

questions.solution:

The cost price is 72% of the selling price.

Concept used:

Profit% = {(Selling Price - Cost Price) over Cost Price} times 100\%

Calculation:

Let the selling price be 100x.

Cost price = 100x × 72% = 72x

Now, profit% = frac {100x- 72x}{72x} times 100\% ≈ 38.89%

∴ The profit percentage is 38.89%.

questions.question: A policeman sees a chain snatcher at a distance of 500 m. He starts chasing the chain snatcher who is running with a speed of 5 m/s while the policeman is chasing him with a speed of 15 m/s. What is the distance covered by the chain snatcher when he is caught by the policeman?
questions.solution:
Given:

A policeman sees a chain snatcher at a distance of 500 m.

Speed of the snatcher = 5 m/s

Speed of the policeman = 15 m/s

Concept used:

1. Time taken to meet for two objects coming towards each other = Intermediary distance ÷ Relative speed

2. Relative speed is the difference between individual speeds while two objects run in the same direction.

3. Distance = Speed × Time

4. km/h = 5/18 m/s

Calculation:

Time taken to catch the snatcher by the policeman = 500 ÷ (15 - 5) = 50 seconds

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3284440430bee8e6c457162d56e92a6357b17b8bda92cbb7d665e8560d282856.png] 

Now, the distance covered by the chain snatcher when he is caught by the policeman = 50 × 5 = 250 m

**∴ The distance covered by the chain snatcher when he is caught by the policeman is 250 m.**

questions.question: A number when divided by 7 leaves remainder of 4. If the square of the same number is divided by 7, then what is the remainder?
questions.solution:
Given:

A number when divided by 7 leaves a remainder of 4. 

Concept used:

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

Calculation:

Let the number and quotient be N and D respectively.

​According to the question,

N = 7D + 4

⇒ N² = (7D + 4)²

⇒ N² = 49D² + 56D + 16

⇒ N² = 7(7D² + 8D + 2) + 2

So, 7(7D2 + 8D + 2) is completely divisible by 7.

Now, the remainder is 2.

∴ The remainder is 2.

questions.question: If cot B = 9, then what will be the value of sec² B?
questions.solution:
Given:

cot B = 9

Concept used:

1. cosec² θ - cot² θ = 1

2. sin² θ + cos2 θ = 1

3. sin θ = 1/cosec θ

4. cos θ = 1/sec θ

Calculation:

cot B = 9

⇒ cot² B = 81

⇒ 1 + cot2 B = 1 + 81

⇒ cosec² B = 82

⇒ sin² B = 1/82

⇒ 1 - sin² B = 1 - 1/82

⇒ cos² B = 81/82

⇒ sec² B = 82/81

**∴ The value of sec2 B is 82/81.**

questions.question: The LCM of two numbers is 120 and the numbers are in the ratio 3 ∶ 8 The sum of the numbers will be :
questions.solution:
Given:

The LCM of two numbers is 120 and the numbers are in the ratio 3 ∶ 8.

Concept used:

1. HCF is the largest number or quantity that is a factor of each member of a group of numbers.

2. LCM is the smallest common multiple of two or more numbers.

Calculation:

Let the numbers be 3x and 8x respectively.

Sum of the numbers = 3x + 8x = 11x

​According to the question,

LCM (3x, 8x) = 120

⇒ x × 3 × 8 = 120

⇒ x = 120/24

⇒ x = 5

⇒ 11x = 55

∴ The sum of the numbers will be 55
